diagnosis: The search endpoint returns highlighted content snippets from SupportTicket across all clients without scoping results to request.user.organization. An authenticated customer searching for terms like 'password' or 'invoice' can see highlighted snippet excerpts from other customers' tickets.
exploit_request:
GET /api/support/search/snippets/?q=payment+credentials HTTP/1.1
Host: help.saasdesk.io
Authorization: Bearer <customer_jwt>
